crossRefs.note: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.
Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

translations.web: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.
translations.bsb: There they cry out, but He does not answer, because of the pride of evil men.
translations.kjv: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
translations.asv: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.
